verdict.rationale: YubiKey is closed hardware/firmware — community evidence explicitly notes it is 'a proprietary smartcard' and that Yubico 'does not permit firmware flashing,' with no vendor claim or evidence of the core product's source being published under an open license. Some client SDKs/CLIs (python-fido2, ykman) are open-source, but that is tooling around the product, not the product's own source.
